newsitem.title: INDIA: Separatists kill 5 Indian soldiers in bomb attack.
newsitem.headline: Separatists kill 5 Indian soldiers in bomb attack.

text.p: Separatist guerrillas killed five Indian soldiers, including a military officer, in a bomb attack in the northeastern state of Assam on Friday, police said.

They said guerrillas of the United Liberation Front of Asom (ULFA) exploded a remote-controlled bomb on a vehicle carrying the soldiers at Hostapur village, some 100 miles (160 km) from the state's main city, Guwahati.
Maoist ULFA has been fighting since 1979 for a homeland in the oil and tea rich province, and accuses New Delhi of exploiting forest and mineral resources of the state without benefiting its people.
